verdict_order: nothing missing, nothing extra, multiplicity ok -> STRONGLY_CONSISTENT
nothing missing, multiplicity ok, extra phases -> CONSISTENT
at least one experimental phase reproduced -> PARTIALLY_CONSISTENT
multiplicity_rule: judged only where the paper reports two or more instances of one family; satisfied when the calculation returns at least as many
Cr2Nb_rule: admitted against either Laves polymorph; the polymorph is not assumed and the calculated one is reported as a result
unmappable_rule: excluded from the metric denominator and reported, never force-matched
absent_from_database_rule: counted as a missing experimental phase, because the description cannot produce it
chemistry_gate: stage 40 may downgrade a set-level verdict on measured phase chemistry; it can never upgrade one
